He climbed down at low tide, boots slipping on weed, and worked the cork free with his knife. Inside lay a scrap of paper, soft with damp, the ink feathered but readable. It thanked whoever found it for keeping the light burning through a bad November, and signed only with a ship's name he had watched pass twenty years back. He stood a long while with the surf at his ankles. Then he carried the note up the spiral stair and pinned it above the lamp, where it has stayed since.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝色里。街灯一盏盏亮着，照着空无一人的路面。偶尔有出租车驶过，水迹在柏油上拖出短短的光。便利店的玻璃里透出冷白的灯，店员靠在柜台打盹。远处高楼只亮着零星几扇窗，像没睡的眼睛。送奶车停在巷口，脚步声清脆。风从河面吹来，带着一点凉意。天边极淡的灰白正慢慢漫开，白昼还没来，夜却已经疲倦了。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n- You keep making the problem smaller until it is so tiny the answer is obvious, and that tiny case is where you stop.\n- Think of standing between two mirrors: each reflection holds another, smaller reflection inside it, all the way down."}
